item.title: US Withdrawing All Forces From Syria, Over A Year After Regime Change by Proxy War
item.description: Last week we and others reported that American forces finally after many years withdrew from the remote Al-Tanf Garrison, a base in southern Syria near the borders of Iraq and Jordan. item.title: Abu Dhabi Funds Held Over $1 Billion of BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF at End of Last Year
item.description: At the end of last year, two Abu Dhabi-based funds owned more than $1 billion of BlackRock’s leading spot Bitcoin ETF, according to filings from Tuesday. The sovereign wealth fund Mubadala Investment Company said it owned 12,702,323 shares in BlackRock’s fund, ticker symbol IBIT, worth roughly $631 million. item.title: Why is Britain spending billions to surrender its territory?
item.description: Nick Cooksey looks at the expensive and potentially dangerous mess the Labour government has got Britain into over its Chagos ‘deal’ Britain’s Labour government signed a treaty with Mauritius in May 2025, transferring sovereignty over the Chagos Archipelago in the Indian Ocean, a British sovereign territory since 1814. To secure a 99-year extendable lease on Diego Garcia, the largest island in the archipelago and home of the joint UK-US military base, Britain agreed to pay billions to Mauritius.
